title: A Symbol bullet lifts a Calibri list line to the Symbol ascent plus the text descent at 10/11/12 pt (12.72/14.04/15.36), Wingdings and text-face bullets never do, a line multiple adds (m - 1) x the text single line; the lift survives a Normal that names only an East Asian face
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf item baselines, Letter, Calibri docDefaults, Normal rFonts eastAsia DengXian only, three-item lists: Symbol U+F0B7 10/11/12 pt single 12.72 / 13.92-14.16 / 15.36, line 276 14.40-14.64 / 16.08 / 17.28-17.52; Wingdings U+F0A7 12.24 / 13.44 / 14.64 and 13.92-14.16 / 15.36 / 16.80; text-face U+2022 the same as Wingdings. gen before the fix: the lift took the Normal's `font` (DengXian) as the text face and gave up (--li-marker-lh: 0, 15.4 pitch at 11 pt x 1.15 where Word has 16.08)

cases.note: Word 13.92 / 14.16 alternating on the 0.24 pt device grid
Wingdings (asc 0.8989) never lifts: 14.64 = the Calibri 12 line
Symbol 11 pt item under the EA-only Normal: lifted (Word 13.92-14.16)
Symbol 11 pt at line 276: lift + (m - 1) x single (Word 16.08)
Wingdings 11 pt: the substitute glyph's face must not grow the line (Word 13.44)
text-face bullet 11 pt: no symbol face, no lift (Word 13.44)
